claims.text: The applicant is enrolled in Yuan Ze University's Master of Finance and Accounting programme.
The portfolio repeatedly implements evidence-governed agentic systems in which model reasoning is separated from deterministic evidence, constraints, and human authority.
Blowback implements a local-first Playwright application-preparation operator that fills declared fields and uploads while preserving an explicit human final-submit gate.
Blowback implements deterministic opportunity gating, provenance-safe claim projection, and external outcome recording above the browser operator.
Hardware-Splicer implements a current-SDK MCP gateway generated from the canonical FastAPI/OpenAPI backend rather than a separate hand-maintained truth store.

Hardware-Splicer implements a dual-agent engineering workflow that preserves identity, evidence provenance, deterministic engineering constraints, explicit unresolved state, and closed physical authority.
Research Drive implements bounded MCP-directed public catalogue search planning with query provenance and a separate inspect-only agent review candidate set.
Public-Good Control implements evidence-bounded, human-authority-preserving decision support across multiple public-good domains, including retrospective disaster replay and governance analysis.
Sharpe Terminus implements a causal walk-forward promotion path, explicit statistical evidence gates, append-only research search accounting, and a separate capital-authorization boundary.
Refinery's Demand Observatory persists reviewed real demand observations while keeping attention, pain, adoption, commitment, and spend as separate evidence dimensions.
Hardware-Splicer has demonstrated successful live unseen-model competence on the frozen SPI case.
Hardware-Splicer has demonstrated real physical correctness on the frozen SPI case.
Hardware-Splicer has demonstrated successful use by an independent operator without maintainer engineering takeover.
The portfolio has demonstrated recurring commercial revenue from its flagship systems.
